label: One resource lower bound throughout…: PastLowerBound S now L says L≤S t for every integer t≤now…
term: one resource lower bound throughout the past
definition: PastLowerBound S now L says L≤S t for every integer t≤now, including now. L is one fixed real constant for the whole past, not a varying bound or a finite observed interval. Combined with the finite real value S now, it bounds the accumulated past-to-present stock increase by S now−L. It asserts no finite duration since a first event.
note: Open resource restriction, not a proved fact about physical entropy or a closed universe. The theorem assumes this predicate and does not select it as the premise to retain when the joint profile is rejected. The declaration body is exactly ∀ t, t ≤ now → L ≤ S t, with S : Int → Real and fixed now/L parameters. It is a property of the stock, not the stock carrier itself. Declaration completion supplies neither a proof of this open restriction nor a duration, causal-priority or well-foundedness conclusion.
